descriptions.en: A HACS custom integration that prints text, QR codes and images on inexpensive Bluetooth thermal “cat” printers using Home Assistant's Bluetooth stack and ESPHome proxies.
descriptions.ko: Home Assistant의 Bluetooth 스택과 ESPHome 프록시를 통해 저렴한 Bluetooth 감열식 “고양이 프린터”에 글자·QR 코드·이미지를 인쇄하는 HACS 커스텀 통합입니다.

categories_review.source: README Features and requirements and docs/user-guide.md: Bluetooth thermal printers produce physical text, QR codes and images; printers is the primary actual product category. Entity platforms do not determine this selection.
